tbpn_example.episode_title: Defense Tech Day (Delian Asparouhov, Dhruva Rajendra, Steven Simoni, Chris Power, Aaron Slodov, AJ Piplica, Connor Love, Cameron McCord)

blocking_issues: tbpn default: all three idea-bearing labels (sc_measure_corpus_moat, sc_machines_brownfield, sc_materials_nomaker) are drawn across their own gold rings; the extension's label offset -(rec.r + 1.3) measures from the mesh radius and does not clear the derived halo, the idea ring, or the label's own half-height on a size-1.25 node.

Same root cause hits c_materials_moisture (classic) and sc_materials_conflict (tbpn), with c_manpower_loop and sc_machines_nocomputers grazing. report.json's overlap metric only counts label-vs-label pairs so it reports 0 and misses all of this.
suggestions: The spine arrow cone floats: tip at x 29, head outline starts at x 30, thick spine stops at x 24.
Rib guides are fainter than the derived dashed edges, so the bones are the least salient layer.
classic facts-only: the Manpower bone runs to y -34.5 but its only fact node sits at y -10.5, so it competes with the deliberately bare Machines bone.
Both panel shots have the side panel covering the fish head and the effect node.
Neither panel screenshot exercises a derived node, so rationale + confidence rendering was not confirmed visually.

snap.mjs clicks the effect node for the panel shot in both examples, so the derived-node panel is never captured; the engine does render it. Orchestrator fix: have snap click a derived idea node for the tbpn panel shot, e.g. sc_measure_corpus_moat.
The side panel is an opaque column over the right ~350px of the stage, so in both panel shots it covers the fish head and the effect node the shot is about. Engine scope.

On the tbpn Machines and Materials ribs the sub-cause nodes are collinear with their cause, so the fact edge f_nocomputers_old is overdrawn by the derived d_brownfield_old, and f_conflict_nocnc by d_nomaker_nocnc; along those two ribs the solid/dashed cue is carried only by the node rendering.
Rib guides run to the outermost node including derived ones, so in facts-only some ribs end in bare tails.
MANPOWER is the tightest label, ending about 13px short of the head outline at the default camera in both examples.
Several edges pass through label text (tbpn f_offshore_aging across 'Export control keeps the data offline'; classic g_moisture_lots across 'Gauge 14 months since calibration'); readable at 1400x900.
The legend keeps the gold-ring idea key in the facts-only view where all three idea nodes are hidden. Engine scope.
viz_reviews.summary: Reads as a fishbone immediately: grey spine bar terminating in an arrow and a pentagon head holding the effect box, six ribs alternating up and down, causes on the ribs and sub-causes further out. Category labels offset to their own rib's side so the top row reads Methods, Machines, Materials and the bottom Measurements, Milieu, Manpower. Provenance is the strongest part: in classic facts-only the Machines rib is a bare bone because its only cause is an inference; in tbpn all six fill from one speaker and the three idea nodes carry gold rings. 0 overlapping label pairs, 0 off-screen, 0 under cards, console clean in both examples and both views; stats lines match graph.json in all four states. Legibility 4 because a few edges cross label text and two tbpn ribs overdraw collinear fact and derived edges.

notes:
Research: Kaoru Ishikawa, Kawasaki shipyards, 1960s. The six 6M categories are structural scaffolding per SPEC 3: provenance "schema", no quote/confidence/rationale, excluded from the fact/derived counts, and the registry already marks the slot structural.
Edge provenance decision: belongs_to (cause to category) and the category-to-effect spine edges are provenance "schema" - they are the bones of the fish, not claims about the world, so they stay visible when derived is hidden and the fishbone survives the facts-only view. The 6M filing of a specific cause is a judgment; where it is genuinely contestable (the TBPN 'no public corpus' cause reads as Measurements but could be filed as Materials, and 'no lot traceability' in the classic comes from a purchasing sentence but is a records failure) the judgment is discussed in the README rather than hidden in an edge confidence. Recorded here so a later reviewer does not read the schema edges as a provenance claim.
Scout returned three candidates; picked #1 (Chris Power / Hadrian) because it is the only one that populates all six ribs from a single speaker, and it sits in Ishikawa's home domain of manufacturing. Rejected #2 (Mike Gallagher on Navy shipbuilding, Materials rib empty) and #3 (Air India 787 crash, Materials empty and Machines thin).
Empty-rib demonstration: the TBPN source fills all six ribs with facts, so the 'a rib can be empty' lesson is carried by the classic example instead - the minutes end with 'Nobody from maintenance attended the circle, and the mould tool was not discussed', so the Machines rib holds exactly one derived node (c_machines_tool, 0.5). With derived hidden, that bone is visibly bare, which is the diagnostic Ishikawa exists to produce.
Provenance shape: this framework is extraction-heavy. Facts dominate (classic 9/4, tbpn 13/5) because a fishbone's causes are usually said out loud; the inference concentrates at the sub-cause tips, which is why idea_bearing_slot is "subcause".
Validate: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
Viz loop: 2 iterations, critic passed at iteration 2 (demonstrates 5, provenance 5, legibility 4, fidelity 5). Iteration 1 was marked revise for one root cause: the extension parked every label one mesh-radius below its node, which does not clear a derived node's wireframe halo or an idea node's gold ring, so five labels were drawn across their own marker. Iteration 2 recomputes the offset from what the engine actually draws (shape extent x radius, x1.35 for the halo, at least r*1.71 for the idea ring, plus a 2.0-world label allowance) and places each label on the outward side of its bone; a scratchpad probe that solves the world-to-screen affine from the label anchors confirmed 0 label-over-glyph intersections in both examples, which report.json cannot see because it only counts label-vs-label pairs.
Reconcile: README verified against graph.json programmatically - every non-schema node id, text, verbatim quote, [fact] / [derived 0.xx] tag, rationale and idea sentence appears in the README, and every edge id with its endpoints and confidence; the count claims in the README (classic 9 fact / 4 derived, tbpn 13/5, 6 schema categories and 15 schema edges each) match. The jq comparison of the current graph.json against the scaffold commit 94f7b9b with layout fields and labels stripped is byte-identical, so the viz loop changed nothing but layout; no label was shortened in either iteration.
Link note: ../../04-sensemaking-and-complex-systems/systems-thinking/README.md in Related frameworks is a forward reference to a framework not yet built. Left as is - it matches house style (carl and five-whys carry the same forward references) and resolves once that folder exists. Every other link resolves.
Engine rebuild at reconcile: `node _meta/build.mjs` pulled in three shared-engine commits that landed during this run (1191ac8 anchor node labels below what the node draws, 10255ae make the node-label offset actually apply, 6e1c011 metrics see edge labels plus a layout annotation primitive). The extension sets rec.label.position after layout, so it still wins and nothing double-applies. Re-snapped after the rebuild: metrics and stats lines identical to the run the critic judged (classic default 19 labels 0/0/0, facts-only 15 0/0/0; tbpn default 24 0/0/0, facts-only 19 0/0/0; console clean), and the fishbone still reads correctly in both examples.
Open items for the orchestrator, from the critic's suggestions, all engine-level rather than page-level: snap.mjs always clicks the first .nlabel in DOM order (the effect, a fact node), so no panel screenshot ever exercises a derived node - the builder verified separately that a derived node's panel renders the DERIVED badge, confidence, rationale, supported-by and the opportunity section; resetView insets for the side panel but is not called when the panel opens, so the panel covers the fish head, which on a fishbone is where the effect is by convention; and the legend keeps the gold-ring idea key in the facts-only view where every idea node is hidden.
Final review: source.episode_title was the extraction slug 'defense-tech-day-reindustrialization-tariffs' and printed on the page header and in the README; replaced with the readable title built from the transcript file name, in graph.json, README.md and state.json.
